text:
anya: Heads up — Nebula Labs confirmed hardware preview next week. NDA signed yesterday, they want telemetry + micro-benchmark access before the on-site handoff. Can eng + infra confirm readiness?
lee: on it. what's the expected perf vectors? memory, latency p95, and token throughput?
anya: yep those 3. Also want KV-cache hit rates and failure traces for OOMs. Nebula asked for a lightweight agent to push metrics to their collector (read-only).
marco: need legal signoff on the read-only collector endpoint. @legal-bot any flags?
legal-bot: Quick read: NDA allows telemetry sharing with opt-out for PII. We need an explicit data map from eng showing fields. No keys or raw user prompts.
taylor: tech ask — do we give them direct network access or push via our relay? security prefers relay + signed certs.
nebula-eng: (Nebula) we can accept a push model. prefer an s3-compatible sink with ACLs, or a temporary pre-signed upload. we don't need live shells.
lee: s3 sink works. propose: push daily bundles + streaming traces for errors only. Will add a per-bundle manifest with schema version.
anya: schedule-wise: bench run on Tue, Wed for 2x configs (8xA100 equiv, 4xA100 equiv). On Thu we'll do joint walkthrough. Can infra provision the lab images by Monday EOD?
marco: infra can provision images, need the exact AMI/container tags. also need the quantization profiles to pre-install.
lee: attaching minimal config snippet I'm going to use for the run: ```
bench: nebula-preview-2025
model: redwood-v1-7b
quant: int8-llm
batching:
  max_tokens: 2048
  batch_max: 16
telemetry:
  sink: s3://nebula-nebulab-preview/ingest
  manifest: true
```
lee: I'll open a PR with full infra playbook.
taylor: note: add firewall rule to only allow Nebula IP range and our relay. I'll stamp once PR is up. :white_check_mark:
anya: action list: 1) lee -> PR with infra playbook + schema (due Mon noon) 2) marco -> legal + security checklist updated (due Mon EOD) 3) taylor -> firewall + certs (due Mon EOD) 4) nebula-eng -> confirm sink details + rotation policy (due Mon noon).
nebula-eng: confirming sink path and rotation policy. we'll consume bundles for 30 days and rotate creds every 24h.
sre-bot: Reminder: scheduled bench window 2025-10-07 09:00-17:00 UTC. Auto-snapshot enabled for each run.
anya: great. if anyone sees blockers post them here. otherwise i'll loop in solutions engineering + PM for announcement planning after Thu walkthrough. :rocket:
